{{Wireless adapter |brand=Doodle Labs |model=ACM-TB-3 |est_release_date=2014 |manuf_country=Singapore |is_manuf=Yes |manuf_model=ACM-TB-3 |if=Mini PCIe |if_bus_version=1.1 |form_factor=Mini Card |chip1_brand=Qualcomm Atheros |chip1_model=QCA9890 |accessible_UART=No |flags=Public Safety Band, military grade |ant_conn=MMCX |802dot11_protocols=abgn+ac |txchains=3 |rxchains=3 |sstreams=3 }} {{ProductPage|http://www.doodlelabs.com/products/802-11-wifi-mimo-radio-transceivers/}}
Additional specifications, per the manufacturer's site, follow.. *Noted as being tri-band, supporting 2.4 GHz (2402 ~ 2482 MHz), PSB (4940 ~ 4990 MHz), and 5 GHz (5180 ~ 5825 MHz) bands *Receive sensitivity: ranges from -100 to -62 dBm, +- 2 dBm **Receiver LNA gain: +15 dBm **'high selectivity band-pass filters' are noted as being used *Tx power: up to 22 dBm per stream w/ QAM16 (MCS4), 27 dBm aggregate for 3 streams *Ambient operating temp. range: -40°C to +70°C *Dimensions: noted as [[Dimensions::30 mm x 50 mm x 6 mm]] *<small>additionally, ''loopback'' mode is supported to assist with FIPS [[wikipedia:Advanced Encryption Standard|AES]] certification</small> and <small>integrated GPS ('''SiRF Star IV''', includes power feed for an active antenna) or USB hub capability is also (optionally) available</small>
